title: A note on rounding fractional matchings with constant-factor strong negative correlation
summary: We describe new dependent-rounding algorithms for bipartite graphs. Given a fractional matching $x$ of graph $G = (U \cup V, E)$, the algorithms return an integral solution $X$ such that each right-node $v \in V$ has at most one edge, and where the variables $X_e$ also satisfy broad non-positive correlation properties. In particular, for any edges $e_1, e_2$ sharing a left-node $u \in U$, the variables $X_{e_1}, X_{e_2}$ have *strong* negative-correlation, i.e. the expectation of $X_{e_1} X_{e_2}$ is significantly below $x_{e_1} x_{e_2}$.
